notes: Ludum Dare 57 game Umbrage by JereNurminen (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/umbrage). Complete Unity 6000.0.22f1 project with playable scene Assets/Test.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings (Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity is present but disabled in the build list). MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2025 Jere Nurminen); the LICENSE states it pertains to files under Assets except two attributed third-party files. Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): URP 17.0.3, Input System 1.11.2, 2D feature 2.0.1, AI Navigation 2.0.4, Timeline 1.8.7, uGUI 2.0.0, Visual Scripting 1.9.4, Multiplayer Center 1.0.0, ads/analytics/purchasing, collab-proxy, IDE packages, test framework, macOS toolchain, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0 because they pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset; the playable scene does not require it. No TMP Documentation or Examples & Extras were present. The C&C Red Alert [LAN].ttf font and its generated TMP SDF asset (N3tRunn3r, explicitly excluded from the MIT grant; recreation of copyrighted Command & Conquer typography) were omitted along with their .meta files; GUID references may remain in UI prefabs. Background music cool-hip-hop-loop-275527.mp3 (SergeQuadrado via Pixabay, Pixabay Content License, Published 2024-12-16, also excluded from the MIT grant) was omitted along with its .meta file because the Pixabay Content License is not whitelist OSS and forbids redistributing the unaltered audio as a standalone file; GUID references may remain in the scene, consistent with the omitted C&C Red Alert font. .DS_Store files were omitted. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/LFS/DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~241M src snapshot (size is mostly author-made MIT level prefabs; git-compressed upstream is ~8MB).
